about_the_game:
Boss‌Fish is a relaxing casual idle simulation game that can be placed anywhere on your desktop.During your work or study breaks, create your personalized fish tank.You can purchase fish packs, raise adorable baby fish to earn profits,or keep them in your tank to generate continuous income.Use the profits you earn to purchase decorations and create your own unique fish tank, which will accompany you in your work and study time.

  • Unlock new Fish Species

  Buy fish packs to unlock a wide variety of species. Discover rare fish through random draws and unlock exclusive appearances.

  • Decorate Your Fish Tank

  Customize your tank with multiple decorations, each offering bonus effects to boost breeding efficiency. Choose from various tank designs to beautify your desktop.

  • Other Features

  Freely place the fish tank anywhere on your desktop and adjust its size as you like.Includes a one-click minimize function that won’t interfere with your normal work or study.

  It can achieve simple automation to help you make money efficiently.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows10
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: BossFish is a casual simulation game where you raise adorable little fish to earn coins, purchase decorations, and build a fully customized aquarium.The game sits anywhere on your desktop, letting you interact with your live aquarium during work or study breaks.
